newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares open firm, Jardine units soar.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares open firm, Jardine units soar.

text.p: Singapore shares were firmer at the open on Tuesday with the Jardine stable of companies soaring on talk of Hong Kong tycoon Li Ka Shing buying into them, dealers said.
Hongkong Land topped the actives with more than 16 million shares changing hands in the first hour of trading. It was up 53 cents to US$3.08.
Jardine Matheson rose US$1.10 to US$8.15 and Mandarin Oriental was up seven cents to US$1.19.

"There is talk that Li will accumulate up to five percent in the open market in Hongkong Land and Jardine Matheson and it is also negotiating to buy a bigger stake in either of the companies," a broker with a European firm said.
A Hong Kong newspaper report said Li's Cheung Kong had bought a three percent stake in Jarding Matheson and Hongkong land. Jardine officials were not available for comment.
Elsewhere in the market, property, banking and electronic stocks were slightly firmer after Monday's declines.
"There is some bargain hunting going on but it could just be a technical bounce," a dealer said.

Aztech Systems rose five cents to S$0.64 in early active trading after it said it was introducing a new sound card. Rival Creative Technology also gained S$1.30 to S$31.10 following overnight gains on Nasdaq.
